Console: A console implementation that sends messages to the V8 inspector's remote console, mirroring Node's `inspector.console`. Each method matches its `console` counterpart (`log`, `error`, `warn`, `dir`, `table`, `time`/`timeEnd`, `group`/`groupEnd`, `count`, `trace`, etc.).
Console.DirOptions: Options for `dir()`: `colors`, `depth`, and `showHidden`, matching `util.inspect()`'s options of the same names.
Session: Dispatches messages to the V8 inspector back-end and receives responses and notifications, mirroring Node's `inspector.Session`. `onpaused` is called whenever the debugger pauses; return `true` to keep the pause, or a falsy value to resume immediately.
Session.connect: Connects the session to the inspector back-end, enabling `post()` to send messages. A no-op if already connected or destroyed.
Session.connected: Whether the session is connected and not destroyed.
Session.post: Posts `method` (with optional `params`) to the inspector back-end. Resolves or calls `cb` with the result, or with an `Error` if the inspector returns one.
Session.destroy: Destroys the session, releasing its inspector back-end handle. A no-op if already destroyed.
Session.destroyed: Whether the session has been destroyed.
Session.InspectorSessionEvents: The events a `Session` emits: `inspectorNotification` for every inspector notification, and one event per inspector protocol method name (e.g. `'Debugger.paused'`) carrying the same message.
Session.SessionMessage: An inspector protocol notification: the `method` name and its `params`.
Server: A WebSocket server exposing a `Session` for remote debugging, compatible with Chrome DevTools and mirroring the endpoints Node's `--inspect` exposes (`/json/list` and a WebSocket debugger URL).
Server.address: Returns the address the server is listening on.
Server.close: Stops the server from accepting new connections, destroys existing connections and the underlying debugger session, and calls `cb` once closed.
Server.listening: Whether the server is currently listening for connections.
Server.ref: Marks the server so the event loop won't exit while it's listening.
Server.unref: Unmarks the server so the event loop can exit even while it's listening.
Server.InspectorServerEvents: The events an inspector `Server` emits: `listening`, once the server starts listening.
Server.InspectorServerOptions: Options for `Server`: `path`, the entry-point URL reported to DevTools as the URL of the inspected script.
HeapSnapshot: A readable stream of a V8 heap snapshot taken over `session`, using the inspector protocol's `HeapProfiler.takeHeapSnapshot`. Pipe it to a file (e.g. with a `.heapsnapshot` extension) to load it in Chrome DevTools.
